5. Listen to the next part of Lily’s story Clara wrote

Listen without reading the script the first time. On your second listen, open it if you need a little help.

Show listening script

Lily woke up surrounded by everything she thought she wanted. But something was wrong. Despite all these things, she felt empty. The more she had, the more she realized how much she had lost in the process.

Her selfishness had shaped her life, and now she saw how it had all been for nothing. She had chased after material things, thinking they would make her happy, but all they did was isolate her and deepen her emptiness.

As she stared at herself, Lily felt the weight of her own choices. She had become someone she didn’t recognize—selfish, entitled, and distant from what truly mattered. It wasn’t the world that had failed her; it was herself. Only by letting go of her selfish desires and facing the truth about who she had become could she ever find real happiness and freedom.

Show possible answers

Clara may wish to undo the consequences of her selfish wishes and find genuine happiness and freedom.

She has learned that chasing material possessions can isolate her, that her choices have consequences, and that happiness is not determined by what she owns.

The story continues in Lesson 7. There is no branching choice this time.
